frozen.kind: chromium frozen review; no server order, payment, mail, or entitlement acceptance
checks: missing bundled artwork does not block an uploaded-photo starter
Finish freezes exact editable source and local archive, with true desktop and mobile review sizes
later draft edits and reload preserve the exact frozen revision and download
explicit new review advances to the newer draft while retaining the previous frozen record
truncated embedded image cannot freeze or replace a prior valid package
frozen preparation does not call a payment, mail, AI, storage, or provider API

account.environment: Isolated Chromium; controlled local account responses; no real identity/provider/cloud acceptance
checks: start-screen account mounts and reads only on request; Escape returns focus
an empty device can resume an account project without saving an unexplained starter
password sign-in keeps local project and Undo history
missing owner and disabled resume capabilities fail closed without writes
session changes clear capability without losing the project
desktop, 390px and 320px toolbar controls and account dialog remain reachable
failed device saving offers backup before separate-tab Google sign-in

challenge.name: challenge-retry
checks: failed dispatched checkout removes the consumed challenge and waits for a fresh verification token
retry keeps the immutable purchase attempt and dispatches only with the fresh token
page identity, no runtime overlay or unexpected console error, no outside network, no horizontal overflow
